entities.name: Glaucias of Macedon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Glaucias of Macedon was an officer of the Companion cavalry at the Battle of Gaugamela.


He may be the Glaucias who, on Cassander's orders, murdered Alexander IV of Macedon and his mother Roxana in the citadel of Amphipolis.


This event has been linked to the tumultuous aftermath of Alexander's death, which saw the Macedonian Empire fragment into various successors and the Ptolemaic Kingdom rise to prominence.


Glaucias' role in this pivotal moment reflects the complex web of alliances and rivalries that characterized the Hellenistic period, where the actions of a single individual could have far-reaching consequences for the balance of power.
